ctu2.sentence: This is a significant reduction from the current logistics cost which stands at around 13 to 14 percent of GDP.

ctu1.sentence: Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by a committee formed by the Ministry.

ctu2.sentence: Upon approval, the applicant will receive a sanction letter detailing the interest subsidy.

ctu1.sentence: The Ministry of Logistics and Transport will oversee the entire implementation of the scheme.

ctu2.sentence: This will not only benefit logistics service providers but also end consumers.

ctu1.sentence: For more information on the scheme, interested parties can visit the official website of the Ministry of Logistics and Transport.

ctu2.sentence: They can also contact the ministry for any queries related to the application process.
